description: Patterns targeting renewal deadlines, notice periods, expiration dates, and time-sensitive obligations. These produce 'Key Dates' entries, not risk flags.

patterns.description: Clause contains auto-renewal language — the agreement renews automatically unless action is taken before a deadline.
patterns.exampleClause: This agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least 60 days prior to the end of the then-current term.

patterns.description: Clause specifies a required notice period — action must be taken within a specific timeframe or rights are forfeited.
patterns.exampleClause: Either party may terminate this agreement upon 90 days prior written notice to the other party delivered by certified mail.

patterns.description: Clause specifies an explicit expiration or termination date for the agreement or an obligation.
patterns.exampleClause: This agreement shall expire on December 31, 2026 unless renewed in writing by both parties at least 30 days prior to that date.

patterns.description: Clause imposes a hard deadline or time limit for performance of a specific obligation.
patterns.exampleClause: Payment must be received no later than 30 days from the invoice date. Time is of the essence with respect to all payment obligations under this agreement.

patterns.description: Clause provides a window after breach notification during which the breaching party may remedy the default before termination.
patterns.exampleClause: In the event of a material breach, the non-breaching party shall provide written notice and the breaching party shall have 30 days from receipt to cure such breach before termination rights arise.

patterns.description: Clause specifies a window during which pricing or other terms may be reviewed, adjusted, or renegotiated.
patterns.exampleClause: Pricing terms shall be subject to annual review and renegotiation during the 30-day window preceding each anniversary of the effective date of this agreement.
